positions.name: NVIDIA Corp.
positions.exitRule: Catalyst-defined: exit 8/26 at the close, BEFORE the Q2 print (8/26 AMC)
positions.catalyst: T2 PRE-EARNINGS POSITIONING: NVIDIA reports fiscal Q2 on Wednesday 8/26 after the close with a $2.07 consensus - the single event that sets the tape for the whole week and the entire AI complex. The trade is the run-up, not the result: enter Monday at 213.45 (-0.59% pre-market, 213.28/213.41, the tightest quote in the book) and be FLAT before the number prints.
positions.risks: THIS IS A POSITIONING TRADE WITH NO EDGE ON THE RESULT, AND THAT IS THE POINT - the exit rule takes the earnings gamble off the table entirely. The run-up does not always happen: NVDA fell from a 218.45 open to a 214.50 low on Friday, so momentum into the print is currently negative, not positive. PE 32.9 and P/B 26.6 on a $5.28T cap - the largest single-name concentration risk in the market. 213.45 is 9.8% below the 236.54 52-week high set in May. If the AI trade cracks on a supply-chain or hyperscaler-capex headline before Wednesday, the exit rule does not protect against the gap.
positions.driver: Tier 2: pre-earnings positioning into 8/26 AMC print, exit before the number

positions.name: Agilent Technologies, Inc.
positions.exitRule: Catalyst-defined: exit 8/26 at the close, BEFORE the FQ3 print (8/26 AMC)
positions.catalyst: T2 PRE-EARNINGS POSITIONING WITH THE BEST CHART IN THE BOOK: Agilent reports fiscal Q3 on 8/26 AMC with a $1.48 consensus. Friday's session set a NEW 52-WEEK HIGH at 160.51 and closed at 159.00 - the only name in today's book making highs rather than bouncing inside a downtrend. Enter at 158.33 and exit before the print.
positions.risks: THE ENTRY PRICE IS THE WEAKEST DATA POINT IN THE BOOK: the last pre-market print was 158.33 at 04:20 ET and the current market is 157.77/165.00, a 4.6% spread, so 158.33 is a stale quote inside a wide, illiquid book. Entering at a fresh 52-week high means there is no overhead reference and no technical support below. PE 31.9 and P/B 6.30 on a life-sciences tools name whose end markets - pharma R&D budgets, China academic and applied-market spending - have been the weak spot in the sector for two years. 1.77M average daily volume is light for a $44.9B cap.

positions.name: Salesforce, Inc.
positions.exitRule: Catalyst-defined: exit 8/26 at the close, BEFORE the Q2 print (8/26 AMC)
positions.catalyst: T2 PRE-EARNINGS POSITIONING INTO A RESET NAME: Salesforce reports fiscal Q2 on 8/26 AMC with a $3.09 consensus. Sentiment has already been reset hard - the stock is 22% below its 269.11 52-week high and PE has compressed to 24.2, near the low end of its multi-year range for a $171B software franchise. Friday's action was constructive (opened 205.58, closed 209.17, near the 211.06 high) and pre-market is +0.40% to 210.00 on a 209.62/209.99 market.
positions.risks: THE DE-RATING IS THE THESIS AND ALSO THE WARNING - CRM is cheap because the market does not believe seat-based enterprise software survives AI-driven consolidation intact, and one quarter will not settle that. The stock bottomed at 146.32 on 6/22, so the recovery is barely two months old and 210.00 is already 43% off that low. Exiting before the print means giving up the actual resolution and keeping only the run-up. 12.5M average daily volume is ample, but a soft read from any of Wednesday's other software prints could hit this before its own number.
